nameEn: Retail sale via stalls and markets of other goods
description: This class includes the retail sale of other goods via market stalls and similar selling points.
includes: retail sale of carpets via market stalls
retail sale of books and recordings via market stalls
retail sale of electrical household appliances via market stalls
retail sale of other goods via market stalls not elsewhere classified
excludes: retail sale of food, clothing via stalls, see 4781, 4782
